# Census of the classes that give a third-party plugin away: which surveyed games ship each one,
# by PROFILE name. Read by plugins_test to check that every profile declaring a plugin has it and
# every profile having one declares it -- a forgotten declaration is a silent screen, and that is
# the failure this whole layer trades for. Regenerate with build_fangame_census.rb after adding a
# plugin or refreshing a dump. Do not edit by hand.
# format: <DetectionProbe> = <profile>, <profile>...   (empty = no surveyed game ships it)
# A probe is a class name, or Class#method for a plugin that brings no class of its own and is
# only given away by a method it adds to one the engine already has.
